metadata.description: Claude Code plugins built because I needed them — harness, ux-ui, peer-coding, free-hands

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Meta-skill that analyzes a project's actual layering / separation-of-concerns and emits project-rules + review-gate.sh + UserPromptSubmit hook + harness-engineering skill from scratch.

plugins.name: ux-ui
plugins.description: Web + mobile: measure the real render (chrome-devtools for web; a mobile MCP or CLI snapshot harness for RN/Flutter/iOS/Android) → art-director critique of the measured snapshots → iterate to elegant → hard-block commits until APPROVED. (adds a PreToolUse commit-gate hook and 4 MCP servers)

plugins.name: peer-coding
plugins.description: Claude × Codex peer orchestration: the two plan, build, and review each other's work as peers, with evidence-based triage, a rebuttal round, and shared project context across both vendors. Unofficial community plugin. (adds a UserPromptSubmit hook; silent when mode is off)

plugins.name: free-hands
plugins.description: Autonomous mode that works through a finite goal checklist without asking or stopping; user-level decisions go to a five-role brainstorming panel. (adds UserPromptSubmit, SessionStart, PreToolUse and Stop hooks)

plugins.name: dashboard
plugins.description: One line above the prompt with the state of every because-i-needed mode you have on; on Codex, a command. (adds a Claude Code hooks module)

plugins.name: budget
plugins.description: Usage gate: when the account's usage window reaches your threshold, every running session stops and asks whether to continue. (adds a Claude Code hooks module and Codex PreToolUse and UserPromptSubmit hooks)

plugins.name: context-rail
plugins.description: Moves file-specific decisions out of always-loaded CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md into PRECEDENT.md records beside the code and installs a project hook that injects a file's recorded decisions — with a confirm-before-changing paragraph — when an agent reads or edits it. Resident instructions only shrink. (writes project files only; the plugin itself adds no hooks)
